intro.text: A skaa servant on the staff of Mansion Renoux in Fellise.

items.text: Skilled at cutting hair, she met Vin and Sazed in the mansion kitchens to style Vin's hair so she could pass as a noblewoman. She praised its beauty but chided Vin for how ill-kept it was, trimmed it with care, and was flattered and embarrassed when Kelsier admired her work.
Once Vin's hair had grown more, she cut and styled it again to fall around her ears with a slight curl.

appearance.text: Middle-aged and fairly tall for a skaa.
